name: botcorp
notes: version = the release tag the daemon stamps into ~/.botcorp/state/harness.json; botYamlSchema gates harness/migrations/*; minClaudeCode is what `botcorp doctor` checks on every host; host.coexist_tasks = *Bot* scheduled tasks that coexist by design (names or *-globs; doctor reports them INFO instead of WARN), extended per machine by <BOTCORP_HOME>/host.json {"coexist_tasks": [...]}.
